Name: Growing Children Expanded (Beta)
Author: neoiw
Description:
[size=6][b]Growing Children Expanded[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A childhood DLC for Stardew Valley — built on Growing Children[/b][/size]

Version 2.9.55 (Beta) · Nexus #50597 · by neoiw · English first · 中文见下方

[quote][b]Beta note[/b]
Save safety and safe removal are core requirements of every release. The mod is large and still being polished; please keep a backup and report bugs with your SMAPI log. GCE is an expansion, not a replacement — Growing Children 1.0.2–1.0.3 and SpaceCore 1.28.4+ are required.[/quote][b]New in 2.9.55[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Have More Kids support.[/b] A child an HMK pack owns (Adopt Leo, Adopt Morgan, RRRR, …) now stays HMK's: its growth stages, behaviour, going outside, work, adult life and dialogue all remain HMK's, so the pack's schedules, dialogue and cutscenes are not overwritten. HMK can no longer claim ordinary (vanilla or re-skinned) children. When both mods declare a child limit, the tighter one wins and the settings page shows which mod set the number in force.[/*]
[*][b]Save Tool: hand a child to HMK, or take it back.[/b] Two steps, reversible, and the child keeps its gender and skin tone. One exception: a child adopted from an NPC stays with HMK, because that NPC is its identity.[/*]
[*][b]Night-out check.[/b] If you go to bed before 24:00, children are no longer treated as "didn't come home": that night counts as not having happened and every child is assumed home. Only when you sleep at 24:00 or later does the check look at where each child actually was. Known limitation, accepted on purpose: a child genuinely away at 23:50 will not be penalised, and the next day's small talk may still mention them coming home early or late.[/*]
[*][b]Hat fixes.[/b] Hats no longer sink or clip while a child walks, and a hat put back on the same day now shows up immediately.[/*]
[/list]
[size=5][b]Also new since 2.9.49[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Make your own child looks.[/b] Use your own 64×224 sprite sheet, portrait, and optional winter/action sheets. Layered Growing Valley-style sets and automatic hat alignment are supported.[/*]
[*][b]Fashion Sense outfits for children.[/b] With Fashion Sense installed, pick a saved outfit in the child's dress-up menu. The mirror can preview the chosen body type, and multiplayer changes are confirmed by the host.[/*]
[*][b]Hair inheritance from NPC parents.[/b] Children now inherit a hand-picked hairstyle from their NPC parent.[/*]
[*][b]A cleaner dress-up menu.[/b] Options are grouped by slot and work with mouse, keyboard, and controller.[/*]
[*][b]Travel, work, and bedtime fixes.[/b] Successful routes are no longer remembered as dead ends; work/home routes, bedtime, and walking hat placement are fixed.[/*]
[*][b]Smoother heavy frames.[/b] The unified scheduler spreads expensive child updates across frames instead of dropping work.[/*]
[*][b]Split-screen and follow-up fixes.[/b] Non-parent greetings, clothed second-screen dialogue portraits, matching work/tool facing, host-authoritative sick-child doctor dialogue, and a batch of travel, bedtime, sick-child and appearance fixes.[/*]
[*][b]Complete 12-language parity.[/b] All 12 catalogs share the same 3,138 keys; the new Fashion Sense, dress-up, and mirror labels are translated in every supported language.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]What you can do[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Grow up.[/b] Six personalities, configurable childhood stages, adult body growth, and gradual maturity.[/*]
[*][b]Choose a life.[/b] Five careers with real tools, native animations, quality, chest returns, and days off.[/*]
[*][b]Live as a family.[/b] Parent-child bond, serious talks, emotions, hugs, TV routines, beds, breakfast, and illness.[/*]
[*][b]Look like themselves.[/b] Dress-up, a separate boots slot, gem hair dye, custom looks, Fashion Sense outfits, and Growing Valley assets.[/*]
[*][b]Go on adventures.[/b] Warrior mining, Skull Cavern escort, low-health warnings, and lethal-blow interception.[/*]
[*][b]Play together.[/b] Native split-screen and online co-op, host-authoritative writes, and per-screen presentation.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Before you install[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]This is not a standalone mod.[/b] GCE is an expansion for Growing Children and requires the base mod. Do not overwrite the base mod's files with GCE files.[/*]
[*][b]Required:[/b] Stardew Valley 1.6+, SMAPI 4.0.0+, Growing Children 1.0.2–1.0.3, and SpaceCore 1.28.4+.[/*]
[*][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for the in-game settings page, Fashion Sense for outfits, and Growing Valley or The Farmer's Children assets.[/*]
[*][b]Folder rule:[/b] keep GrowingChildrenExpanded in its own folder inside Mods, next to the base GrowingChildren folder.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] every player should install the same GCE version.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Install[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install Stardew Valley 1.6+ and SMAPI 4.0.0+.[/*]
[*]Install Growing Children 1.0.2–1.0.3 and SpaceCore 1.28.4+. Both are required.[/*]
[*]Extract the GrowingChildrenExpanded folder into Stardew Valley/Mods. Keep it separate from the base mod.[/*]
[*]Launch the game with SMAPI. No configuration is needed; GCE works out of the box.[/*]
[*]Optional: install Generic Mod Config Menu for the in-game settings page.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Update[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Close the game.[/*]
[*]Replace the contents of the GrowingChildrenExpanded folder with the new version.[/*]
[*]Keep GrowingChildrenExpanded/config.json if you want your settings to persist.[/*]
[*]Relaunch the game and load your save. GCE never force-rewrites config.json on a plain launch.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Uninstall[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Close the game.[/*]
[*]Delete the GrowingChildrenExpanded folder. Your save stays safe; the game falls back to vanilla or the base mod's behavior.[/*]
[*]For a full clean removal, save repair, or recoverable cleanup, use the standalone [b]GCE Save Tool[/b] from the title screen.[/*]
[*]The dark shrine path also remains available; GCE cleans up matching adult NPCs, work agents, caches, pending mail and rewards, relationship residue, and its own persistent state after a confirmed offering.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Full feature list[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Growth and identity[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Children's bodies — and the rest of them — grow with age: through every childhood stage and slowly into adulthood.[/*]
[*]Every childhood stage is configurable: how long the crib, baby, crawler, and toddler stages last, and how many years adulthood and full maturity take.[/*]
[*]Six personalities — Lively, Independent, Curious, Easygoing, Calm, and Careful — change body build, walking, work rhythm, serious-talk answers, bond sources, and even sleeping poses.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50597/50597-1789196502-1982849679.png[/img]

[list]
[*]A child's pace follows the bond: deeper bonds mean lighter steps, faster travel, and a slower rest at night.[/*]
[*]Solo players, co-op players, NPCs, and spouses can all become a child's parents and interact with them.[/*]
[*]Divorce and remarriage are handled with their own mechanics.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Careers and work[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Five careers, each with its own growth path and daily life: farmer, animal caretaker, fisher, forager, and warrior.[/*]
[*]Each child chooses a career at their own coming-of-age moment. The choice belongs to the child.[/*]
[*]Children work with the real tools in their backpack; upgraded tools make their work more efficient.[/*]
[*]They use the player's native tool animations, so every hoe swing, watering pour, and axe chop looks familiar.[/*]
[*]Children return items to your chests and auto-store when their backpack fills.[/*]
[*]You can give a child a day off and let them rest properly.[/*]
[*]Each career has its own habits and welcome lines, and townsfolk connected to the career may stop you for a quick word about your child.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Farmer[/b][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/293224724-1789194835.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]A complete farm routine: hoeing, watering, sowing, fertilizing, and harvesting, with better results as the child gains experience.[/*]
[*]Harvest quality improves over time, and a good breakfast sharpens the day.[/*]
[*]Silver, gold, and iridium quality unlock with experience; a deeper bond brings iridium closer.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Animal caretaker[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Petting, barn and coop chores, and truffle hunting across the farm. The animals answer in their own way.[/*]
[*]Ranch work is handled cleanly; every action counts.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Fisher[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Fish with the real rod from the backpack, at the spot you agreed on or at a random waterside.[/*]
[*]Uses the same native fishing animation and catch settlement as the player.[/*]
[*]A better rod means a shorter wait before the catch.[/*]
[*]Skill and bond make rare fish more likely to bite.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Forager[/b][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/293224724-1789306502.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Plans a gathering route for the day and double-checks before collecting.[/*]
[*]When the farm is picked clean, the child continues into the wild for more.[/*]
[/list][size=3][b]Warrior[/b][/size]

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/293224724-1789193632.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Plans a mining objective, fights with real melee weapons from the backpack, wears boots for defense, and keeps healing food close.[/*]
[*]Real weapons keep their native tricks — dagger flurries, hammer slams, and sword parries — plus a warrior's sense for critical hits.[/*]
[*]Every underground floor the child reaches is announced to you.[/*]
[*]Some nights a warrior chooses to push on, fighting deep into the midnight before heading home to bed.[/*]
[*]When you enter the Skull Cavern, your warrior drops everything to escort you, floor by floor.[/*]
[*]With no monsters or rocks nearby, your warrior takes a guard stance at your back and watches the other direction.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/293224724-1789203574.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]When your health first drops below 30, 20, or 10 percent on a map, a nearby warrior child calls out a warning.[/*]
[*]A killing blow may be intercepted by a high-bond warrior child: the hit is cancelled, the child returns home, and you recover to 30 percent health. At maximum bond, the interception is guaranteed.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Family life[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]One menu for everything: interact with a grown child to open their menu for chats, serious talks, dress-up, work orders, and more.[/*]
[*]The parent-child bond changes through chats, play, gifts, apologies, and the small moments of every day.[/*]
[*]When the bond is full, the number can no longer hold it — some warmth simply cannot be measured.[/*]
[*]Serious talks go deeper: apologizing, praising, encouraging, scolding, listening to complaints, sharing a bad day, and asking about their studies.[/*]
[*]Five feelings have their own effects: encouraged children work with better quality, down children walk a little faster, relief and being heard shield them from gloom, and missing you keeps them close to the farm.[/*]
[*]Toys: most ancient artifacts can become toys. A toy may later be sold, with pocket-money letters, or worn out from play, becoming a memory the child keeps.[/*]
[*]Surprise gifts: children prepare presents for you and can help complete your collection.[/*]
[*]Everyday dialogue and speech bubbles appear when children are near their parents.[/*]
[*]Children love to recount yesterday — the work they did, where they played, how they felt, and who they talked to — in chats and speech bubbles.[/*]
[*]Their own beds and floor beds come with special sleeping poses, hats taken off, and eyes closed late at night.[/*]
[*]Real television rituals: morning fortunes, evening weather forecasts, and cozy daytime shows.[/*]
[*]Grown children hug you and come to you on their own: after work, on stormy nights, or running in with urgent news. Birthdays and thunderstorms bring special lines, and NPC parents give their own hugs.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/293224724-1789195136.gif[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/293224724-1789195063.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Every hug ends with a small emote above the child's head — hearts, smiles, or music notes — chosen by personality and mood.[/*]
[*]When children meet, they stop to chat and answer in short words when busy.[/*]
[*]Bedtime tips, breakfast favorites, and illnesses that keep a child resting until the right cure.[/*]
[*]A sick child's chatter drops hints about which food will help.[/*]
[*]Breakfasts are judged differently: going without stings, a cheap bite disappoints a little, and a fine meal warms the heart.[/*]
[*]A child's favorite food always comes first; a beloved meal counts as a feast at any price.[/*]
[*]A breakfast with alcohol leaves the child tipsy for a while, with slower steps and a wobbly walk.[/*]
[*]When the backpack is empty, a child may help themselves to breakfast from the table.[/*]
[*]Haven't learned the recipe for a cure yet? Harvey can sometimes hand you the right food directly.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Appearance[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]A unified dress-up experience for clothes, hats, pants, boots, hairstyles, and hair colors.[/*]
[*]Boots have their own equipment slot. Children can automatically wear what you hand them from the backpack.[/*]
[*]Dye hair and switch hairstyles with gems and the Prismatic Shard.[/*]
[*]When one parent is a townsfolk NPC, the child inherits a hand-picked hairstyle from that parent.[/*]
[*]Draw your own child looks and place them in GCE's My Looks folders. Layered sets, portraits, winter sheets, action sheets, and automatic hat alignment are supported.[/*]
[*]With Fashion Sense installed, children can wear Fashion Sense outfits saved in your own mirror.[/*]
[*]GCE can read appearance and dialogue assets from Growing Valley, The Farmer's Children, and supported content packs. Missing assets fall back to GCE's own looks.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Birthdays and milestones[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]In-game birthday management, synced between players.[/*]
[*]Parent birthdays too: set your own birthday on the GCE settings page, and the children will remember and celebrate it. The date is synced between players.[/*]
[*]Birthday celebrations with letters and rewards.[/*]
[*]Serious talks can ask a grown child to stay a little longer, putting off their farewell and departure.[/*]
[*]On the night a child finally leaves, the sleep-screen tip becomes a special send-off blessing.[/*]
[*]On the evenings before they leave, parents get a gentle nightly reminder to say their goodbyes.[/*]
[*]Future careers come with their own farewell words. Leaving home brings an arrival letter, festival mail, and pocket-money letters that keep the bond alive.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Life in the valley[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]After work, children choose a leisure spot based on personality and weather.[/*]
[*]A mature pathfinding system takes children door-to-door across real maps, walking every step and replanning around blocked roads.[/*]
[*]They naturally gaze at things that interest them and use furniture and chairs.[/*]
[*]Festival days keep family life normal; rainy days turn toward cozy home activities.[/*]
[*]Adjustable day length: stretch or shorten the in-game day. Time pauses in menus and slows in the mines, fairly shared for every player.[/*]
[*]Family leisure moments: now and then the whole family sets work aside for a shared outing — the saloon, a stroll, or time together at home.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/images/1303/293224724-1789194979.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Leisure mode pauses the shared clock for a valley-wide breather while children pick their own pastimes.[/*]
[*]Shared time flow with fair multiplayer menu-pause, plus an in-game settings page that works with mouse and gamepad.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Multiplayer and screens[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Native local split-screen and online co-op.[/*]
[*]Host-authoritative safe writes; remote parents are validated before any change.[/*]
[*]Per-screen presentation: sleep drawings, speech bubbles, and HUD.[/*]
[*][b]Known limitation:[/b] if a split-screen guest returns to the title and rejoins, children may stop moving until the host reloads the save. This is not save corruption.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Safety and tools[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Standalone GCE Save Tool with backups, previews, and guarded undo. It is a separate optional download.[/*]
[*]You can still offer a child to the dark shrine. You choose which child to send off instead of the vanilla all-at-once behavior, and the offering consumes its Prismatic Shard only after you confirm. GCE cleans up everything behind the scenes.[/*]
[*]Leaving and coming back is handled in-story: uninstall for a while, and children move on with their own letter of explanation.[/*]
[*]Safe update and removal guidance.[/*]
[*]config.json is only written when a setting actually changes.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Localization and settings[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Twelve languages: English, Simplified Chinese, German, Spanish, French, Hungarian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, and Turkish. SMAPI selects the language automatically.[/*]
[*]Every language shares the same 3,138-key catalog (37,656 entries total).[/*]
[*]Optional in-game settings through Generic Mod Config Menu.[/*]
[*]The full bilingual player Wiki is available as a separate download from the Files tab.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]My Looks: draw your own child[/b][/size]

GCE ships no child art and downloads nothing. It reads the images you place in its own folders.

GCE creates three roots inside its mod folder:

[code]GrowingChildrenExpanded/
├── My Looks (GV-shared Simple)/
├── My Looks (Standalone Simple)/
└── My Looks (Standalone Full Function)/[/code][list]
[*][b]Simple roots:[/b] one look per subfolder. Add sprites.png at exactly 64×224. Optional files are portrait.png (64×64 or 128×256), winter.png (64×224), and a 96-wide sprites_action.png.[/*]
[*][b]Layered sets:[/b] a look without sprites.png can be composed from body, shading, clothes, hair, and eye layers. The GV-shared root borrows missing pieces from Growing Valley; the Standalone root uses only your own files.[/*]
[*][b]Full Function root:[/b] an advanced native-geometry sheet, 96×1344 (6×42 frames). Use the template included in that folder.[/*]
[*][b]Hat alignment:[/b] GCE measures the head top in your sheet. If your art needs a manual value, add look.json with {"headTop": 7}. The value must be between 0 and 31.[/*]
[*][b]Templates are guides:[/b] the transparent reference grids inside each folder are not playable art. Do not rename a template to sprites.png.[/*]
[*][b]How to choose it:[/b] open the child menu, choose [b]Dress up[/b], then [b]Appearance source[/b], then [b]My own sprites[/b].[/*]
[*][b]Rights:[/b] use only art you drew yourself or are otherwise allowed to use.[/*]
[*][b]Errors are visible:[/b] a wrong-sized sheet is refused with an in-game notice rather than stretched. A missing optional layer is borrowed or omitted, depending on the root.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Fashion Sense outfits[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Install Fashion Sense separately; it is optional.[/*]
[*]Open the child menu, choose [b]Dress up[/b], then [b]Mod appearance[/b], and pick an outfit you saved in your own Fashion Sense mirror.[/*]
[*]Children cannot design outfits themselves and cannot wear another player's outfit. Each player dresses children with outfits saved in their own mirror.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, the host confirms the change. If the host rejects it, you see one notice and the child's look stays unchanged.[/*]
[*]The wardrobe mirror can switch body type and preview the child's chosen body.[/*]
[*]Oversized shoes are measured and clipped safely, so they do not spill into the cell above.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Tested:[/b] Polyamory Sweet and Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE).[/*]
[*][b]Fashion Sense:[/b] officially supported, including child outfits.[/*]
[*][b]External appearance and dialogue packs:[/b] Growing Valley, The Farmer's Children, and LittleNPCs cleanup are supported.[/*]
[/list][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50597/50597-1789371133-834106462.png[/img]
[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/50597/50597-1789371200-1890796404.png[/img]

[list]
[*][b]Optional companions:[/b] Vanilla Tips and Leisure Time are separate downloads. When installed, Vanilla Tips takes over the sleep-screen tips and Leisure Time retires automatically. GCE works without either one.[/*]
[*][b]Free Love:[/b] supported for multi-spouse child parent identity, pregnancy limits, and parent-change handling (sandbox tested). It uses a different child model from Polyamory Sweet.[/*]
[*][b]Other mods:[/b] no known conflicts with mods that do not change child NPC behavior, but this is not a guarantee. Test a new mod list on a backed-up save.[/*]
[*][b]Pack placement:[/b] do not install Growing Valley or The Farmer's Children as standalone mods alongside GCE. Put each pack's whole folder inside GrowingChildrenExpanded/Supported Other Mods/.[/*]
[*][b]Multiplayer:[/b] every player should use the same GCE version.[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]More than compatible: Fashion Sense[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Fashion Sense is officially supported, not just compatible.[/b] Children can wear full outfits saved in your own Fashion Sense mirror — not just GCE's built-in looks.[/*]
[*]Fashion Sense works alongside GCE's own dress-up, custom looks and Growing Valley assets; nothing has to be replaced.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, the host still confirms the outfit change.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Why I built this[/b][/size]

My wife and I have played Stardew Valley together on split screen for years. When I found Growing Children, which lets the farmer's kids grow up, we were also expecting our first child. I started GCE to keep those stories going — to imagine what our child might love, who they might become, and what they might say.

One early "bug" stayed: if a child finishes watching TV while no parent is home, the TV remains on. It reminded me of coming home to a quiet house and turning on the TV just so it felt like someone was there. That little glow is still in the mod.

[*][b]可选配套：[/b] Vanilla Tips 与 Leisure Time 都是独立下载；安装后，Vanilla Tips 会接管睡前提示，Leisure Time 会自动退休。没有它们，GCE 也能正常运行。[/*]
[*][b]Free Love：[/b] 支持多配偶家庭的孩子家长识别、生育上限与家长变更判定（沙箱实测）；它的孩子模型与 Polyamory Sweet 不同。[/*]
[*][b]其他模组：[/b] 不修改孩子 NPC 行为的模组没有已知冲突，但这不构成保证；新模组列表请先在备份存档上测试。[/*]
[*][b]素材包位置：[/b] 不要把 Growing Valley 或 The Farmer's Children 当作独立模组与 GCE 并列安装；把整个素材包文件夹放进 GrowingChildrenExpanded/Supported Other Mods/。[/*]
[*][b]联机：[/b] 所有玩家应使用相同版本的 GCE。[/*]
[/list][size=4][b]不止兼容：Fashion Sense[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Fashion Sense 是正式支持，而不只是“能共存”。[/b] 孩子可以穿你在自己 Fashion Sense 镜子里保存的整套服装，而不只是 GCE 自带外观。[/*]
[*]Fashion Sense 可以和 GCE 自带装扮、自绘素材与 Growing Valley 素材一起使用，不需要替换。[/*]
[*]联机时，套装改动仍由主机确认。[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]我为什么做这个模组[/b][/size]

我和妻子在客厅分屏玩星露谷已经很多年。发现 Growing Children 时，我们正好也迎来了第一个孩子。于是我接着写这些孩子的故事——想象我们的孩子会喜欢什么、会成为谁、会说什么。

开发早期有个“bug”被我保留了下来：孩子看完电视，如果家里没有大人，电视会一直亮着。它让我想起小时候，父母晚归，我打开电视并不看，只是想让屋里有一点“有人在”的声音。那一点亮光，现在还在模组里。
